# image (#1386, the preload of a 4x target), for the frame builder's 4x

# the command-stream words of its draw and the raw memory of the buffer
# that holds its framebuffer descriptor and its pre-frame draws (DCDs,
# depth/stencil, blend, shader program descriptor, resource table,
# attribute, attribute buffer and its corners, sampler, textures, planes).
#
# Board: NanoPC-T6 (RK3588, Mali-G610, GPU_ID 0xa8670005), Armbian,
# Linux 6.18.55-current-rockchip64, panthor 1.5.0, Mesa 25.0.7-2+deb13u1.
# The program, 0dce654a8:tools/mali/board-ref/2026-10-23-msaa-preload/msaapre.c, by
# the steps of tools/mali/mesa-board-ref.sh
# (PAN_MESA_DEBUG=linear,nocrc,dump,trace,sync): a 64x64 RGBA8 texture
# attached with glFramebufferTexture2DMultisampleEXT(..., 4), a 4x tile
# buffer over single-sampled memory (EXT_multisampled_render_to_texture).
# Source "mesa-msrtt": gl_test case 208 msaapre (frame 1 cleared, a red
#   triangle; glFinish; frame 2 a green triangle with no clear):
#   "verdict case 208 msaapre: PASS".
#   mesa-msrtt.pandecode sha256 c58a4fd6ea37a91bb895bd5983af7eb1887d8f5a35cc7b136fe3406743c97a65
# Source "mesa-msrttz": the same with a 64x64 GL_DEPTH_STENCIL_OES texture
#   attached the same way on DEPTH (frame 1 cleared, depth 1.0, a red
#   triangle at depth 0.5, LESS; frame 2 no clear, a green quad at depth
#   0.75, LESS): Mesa preloads the colour and the depth: "verdict case 208
#   msaapre: PASS".
#   mesa-msrttz.pandecode sha256 6778fb0fa0006154235b4488b90f9fbc445f72de6259716a1f15fc355065cd26
# Cut by tools/mali/board_dump_cut.py --from <line> (past the first
# frame's dump: msrtt 1600, msrttz 1960) with the descriptor buffer
# 7ffffffd0000. Each block is headed by its line range in the full file.
